title: Corner Club and carnival club marches
summary: They discuss playing for the Corner Club, the early start times and long walks of the Buzzers and Lions, and which parade is the easiest job.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Oh, did you say you played for the Corner Club or something? Yeah. Where were they at then?
Corner Club uptown. Mm-hmm. On Washington Avenue. Same place I guess they all know. They used to be around on that street growing up. They wasn't out where they at. Mm-hmm.

Around St. Thomas or Russo somewhere around there. Yeah. How long did you have to march for them? You walked for them all. You get your band up there for seven o'clock in the morning. You're up there for seven. Little after seven they blew the whistle. They're on a hike.

I don't think they start until eight now. They're corner club now starts at eight. But the buzzers and all them, the lines, they all start at seven o'clock. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. They lay up there by the park. Yeah. They got their long heights. They're on a hike.
I don't think they start until 8 now.
They're a carnival club now starts at 8. But the buzzers and all them, the lions, they all start at 7 o'clock.
Yeah, they're out there by the park.
Yeah, they got a long hike.
And they got more to drink, shouldn't they? Oh yeah. Got more stocks to make, I guess. All those ballrooms.
But you see, I put them down because the buzzers now, the buzzers in the corner club is the easiest job up there now.
They get back on the bar.

Yeah, you walk down and then you ride up. You ride up and then you finish up in the territory. So, Anderson said he think, that's until they come up with that hundred dollars. Anderson said he think he gonna give the, I have to call them up. Because they're the only one who got that hard job. The lions. The lions, yeah. Yeah. You see what then happened, a lot of young fellas, them youngsters, is taking the old man's place, the one who's died or the others in the club. And they taking over the children. And they can do that damn walking, man. Man, they skipping up all day long. You see? It don't move them. It don't even move them. You know?
Well, they must be newer. Well, the buzzers I know are the oldest. Huh? The buzzers are the oldest. I know they've been there longer than anybody.
Yeah, the buzzers have been there the longest.
